_about: Fork (docs/OUTFITS.md): English names of the CN-only outfits of data/outfits.json, which the official EN client data does not have yet. Names looked up by @YuriRestia on 2026-10-11 (arknights.wiki.gg; the 自选编队 operators' ones on 2026-10-12 from the operators' Gallery pages); series labels use the official EN brand names of the EN skin_table. tools/build-i18n.mjs tries these only after the official EN text, so an outfit released on Global switches to its official name on the next rebuild. My Little Pony: the collab's own English name (no official EN brand entry yet).
